title: The project report's words as an AI draft
status: Set by Claude at the owner's request (REP2, D-AI-01, D-AI-02; WORDS1, 13-11-2026): an AI drafts six short sections from the user's own inputs, in simple words. A section whose note is left empty is drafted from the other answers: a plan said as a plan, and a fact only the user knows left as a marked blank to fill in. This file's checks drop any sentence that holds a figure the user did not type, a claim a new business cannot have, a figure in a blank, or a fact only the user can give (experience, education, orders) that nothing the user typed says. Nothing goes in the document until every blank is filled and the borrower ticks that the words are true.
source: D-AI-01 (the owner's answer 3 in REP1, 20-10-2026) and Finline's report as the owner met it, finding 6 (docs/design-inputs/finline-2026-10-20.md): a business not yet started called reputable and well-established, with a strong market presence, a loyal customer base and CSR work with NGOs. WORDS1: the owner's ask of 13-11-2026, the process, market and promoter written too, "without over assuming anything but we can make calculated reasonable recommendations based on user input".

sections.label: Introduction
sections.from: who runs the business, what it will do and where, its constitution, and the scheme it applies under

sections.label: The products
sections.from: what the business will sell, from the products named and what it does

sections.label: The process
sections.from: how the products are made or the service given, from the user's note on the process
sections.without: what the business does, its products and what the project's cost covers: the work as it plans to do it, with a blank for where its materials will come from

sections.label: The market
sections.from: who will buy and where, from the user's note on the market
sections.without: the products, the place in the address, whether it is a new unit or a new line, and the scheme: who it plans to sell to and where, with a blank for how it will find its first buyers

sections.label: The promoter
sections.from: the promoter's education and work so far, from the user's note on the promoter
sections.without: the business's name, its constitution and the scheme: who runs it, with blanks for the promoters' names, their education and their years in this trade

sections.label: Conclusion
sections.from: what the project sets out to do, and that the report's tables set out its cost, its finance and how the loan is repaid; never whether it is viable

notes.label: The promoter
notes.hint: Name, education and work so far, in your words. Like “Asha Rao, B.Com; eight years in a packaging firm’s stores”.

notes.label: How it is made or done
notes.hint: The steps, the machines, where the materials come from.

notes.label: Who will buy, and where
notes.hint: The buyers and the places; any orders or talks already.

figures.why: a figure: the report's tables carry every figure

claims.why: customers it does not have yet

claims.pattern: \bmarket presence\b|\bpresence in the market\b|\bstrong presence\b|\bmarket share\b

claims.why: a record it does not have yet

blank.why: a blank must name what to fill in, in words, without a figure

guesses.why: experience you have not told us of
education you have not told us of
buyers or orders you have not told us of
